rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Clockwise degrees the source was rotated to read upright.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: OCR backend that produced this page.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Page-level confidence as the backend defines it; None if it reports none.

text.title: Text
text.description: Serialized page text in reading order — what the LLM reads.

escalated_to_vlm.title: Escalated To Vlm
escalated_to_vlm.description: OCR text passed its gate but failed validation, and a vision-model re-read won.

template_id.title: Template Id
template_id.description: Vendor template that read this document (no LLM extraction); None = model extraction.

SchemaInfo.title: SchemaInfo
SchemaInfo.description: Serializable metadata of a registered schema (what the CLI and HTTP API list).

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-indexed page number where signature was found.

box.title: Box
box.description: Normalized bounding box (ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax) from 0.0 to 1.0.

signatory_label.title: Signatory Label
signatory_label.description: Contextual role (e.g. Customer, Contractor, Director) if labeled.

SignatureDetection.title: SignatureDetection
SignatureDetection.description: Detection of a handwritten signature, mark, or cursive endorsement.

status.title: Status
status.description: verified: exactly one exact match on the page. fuzzy: no exact match, one close window. conflicting: several exact matches, ambiguous. unlocated: the page has no geometry or the quote is not on it.

match.title: Match
match.description: How the quote was found; None when unlocated.

regions.title: Regions
regions.description: Every place the quote was found on the page (usually one), with the normalized coordinates needed to draw a highlight.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Quote match score × mean OCR confidence of the matched words; None when unresolved.

located_by.title: Located By
located_by.description: Backend whose word boxes located the quote. Differs from the page's backend when the page was read by the vision model and the quote was found in the independent OCR reading kept as its witness.

SourceLocation.title: SourceLocation
SourceLocation.description:
Where an extracted value was read: the quote the model cited, and the
page region(s) it resolves to.

`regions` holds every place the quote was found — usually one; a value
that prints twice gives two, and `status` is then `conflicting` because
nothing in the document says which occurrence is the source.

`bbox` and `word_ids` come from matching the quote against the page's
word boxes, never from the model. A page read by the vision model has no
boxes; its quote is then looked up in the OCR reading kept as the page's
witness (`located_by` says which). `bbox` is None when no region
resolved; the top-level copy is the first region's, `regions` carries
the rest.

SourceRegion.title: SourceRegion
SourceRegion.description: One contiguous place a quote was found on a page.

page.title: Page
page.description: 1-indexed page number where stamp was found.

box.title: Box
box.description: Normalized bounding box (ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax) from 0.0 to 1.0.

color.title: Color
color.description: Dominant ink color (e.g. blue, violet, red, black).

shape.title: Shape
shape.description: Geometry of the stamp (circular, oval, rectangular, irregular).

text.title: Text
text.description: Decoded text or organization name from stamp, if legible.

StampDetection.title: StampDetection
StampDetection.description: Detection of a physical seal, official rubber stamp, or organization stamp.

detection.title: Detection
detection.description: 'ruled': drawn cell borders in a PDF; 'aligned': inferred from word alignment only; 'backend': reported by the OCR engine itself.

text.title: Text
text.description: Words joined left to right; ' | ' marks a column-sized gap.

column.title: Column
column.description: Index into PageLayout.columns, when the page has text columns.

table_id.title: Table Id
table_id.description: Set when this line is a row of a detected table.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Backend's recognition confidence; None when it reports none (e.g. a PDF text layer).
